meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein agar aapki acne-prone skin hai aur aapka budget 700 rupees ke andar hai, toh kuch behtareen options available hain jo active acne aur dark spots dono par kaam karte hain:

* **Deconstruct 5% Niacinamide Serum with 0.2% Salicylic Acid** (Price: ~R 599)
Yeh serum acne aur oily skin ke liye ekdum perfect hai. Niacinamide skin barrier ko strong karta aur oil control karta hai, jabki Salicylic Acid pores ke andar jakar acne aur whiteheads ko saaf karta hai.
* **Plum 2% Niacinamide & Rice Water Serum** (Price: ~R 550 - 695)
Agar aapko active acne ke sath-sath acne marks (daag) ki bhi problem hai, toh yeh rice water aur niacinamide ka combination skin ko soothe karta hai aur uneven skin tone theek karta hai.
* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum** (Size 15ml - Price: ~R 549)
Agar aapko blackheads, whiteheads aur active pimples ki zyadatar problem hai, toh yeh serum direct pores ko target karta hai. (Shuruat mein ise hafte mein sirf 2-3 baar use karein).
* **Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum** (Price: ~R 699)
Yeh bhi ek acha option hai jo acne-causing bacteria ko marne aur naye pimples ko aane se rokne mein madad karta hai. Isme witch hazel aur cica bhi hota hai jo redness ko kam karta hai.

**Khareedte waqt kuch baatein dhyan rakhein:**
Aap inhe Nykaa, Purplle, ya inki official websites se discount par aur saste mein khareed sakte hain. Naya serum use karne se pehle patch test zaroor kar lein aur din mein sunscreen lagana na bhulein.
